Absence.name: Absent
Absence.note: Uninhabited-type predicate inside Lean’s metatheory, not absolute Absence. The primitive’s axioms remain in the prose.

Presence.name: Present
Presence.note: The existing local encoding uses type inhabitation.

Identity.name: Identity
Identity.note: Lean equality on one supplied carrier α. Identity holds only between members of that carrier; the encoding gives no criterion for individuating empirical things or reidentifying them across States.

Reality.name: FullLocalRealityMember
Reality.note: Membership in one inhabited carrier, not Reality as the totality of Presence. The source explicitly leaves the global representation open.

Difference.name: Difference
Difference.note: Negated Identity on the same supplied carrier α. It distinguishes members of that carrier only; it does not decide which empirical things are distinct. Change.differs uses this inequality for Transformation endpoints.

Relation.note: The formalization deliberately uses separate typed relations rather than a universal Relation type. No generic definition is supplied.

Set.name: Set
Set.note: Extensional membership on one supplied local carrier. This does not construct all Presence or decide actual membership.

Configuration.name: Configuration
Configuration.note: A member Set plus specified Relation/ordered-participant associations, validated by a supplied interpretation. Equal members need not fix equal Configurations. The finite-tuple projection requires neither nonemptiness nor participant closure; generic State carriers remain unchanged.

Feeds.name: FeedRelation
Feeds.note: A supplied relation on States. Chains applies it to consecutive Transformations.

CausalPath.name: CausalPath
CausalPath.note: The path record permits an empty list; PathEndpoints is the separate nonempty endpoint witness.

Persistence.name: PersistenceWitness
Persistence.note: This witness requires at least two States and an ordered history preserving one Invariant.

Environment.name: Body
Environment.note: A Body-indexed external State scope. This is not a complete independent Environment definition.

Representation.name: Denotation
Representation.note: The expression position of a Denotation. Its carrier is supplied; the field alone does not construct the full prose definition.

Rule.name: FlowRule
Rule.note: A Flow-local Rule encoding. Other modules use SelectionRule, AdaptiveRule or supplied Rule carriers; this is not a universal Rule construction.

Sign.note: No corresponding Sign declaration exists in the audited Lean sources. Denotation alone would omit the Sign’s causal participation.

Symbol.note: No corresponding Symbol declaration exists in the audited Lean sources. A glyph or a type named Symbol would not supply the persistence and Rule conditions.

Language.name: AttributionSemantics
Language.note: Language is a supplied type parameter in this semantic model, not a constructed system of Symbols and Rules.

Map.note: No corresponding Map declaration exists in the audited Lean sources. Consciousness.ReferenceMap instead maps an Agent to an Entity and is not this term.

Reference.note: No corresponding Reference declaration exists in the audited Lean sources. ReferenceMap is a different, proposal-local perspective mapping.

Sense.name: Sense
Sense.note: The current Body-indexed sensing construction joins an environmental input to an internal difference.

Perception.name: Perception
Perception.note: The current Body-indexed Perception produced by its Sense witness.

Record.name: OperativeKnowledge
Record.note: Record is a supplied carrier in this construction. The module explicitly does not construct canonical Records.

Observation.name: IndependentFor
Observation.note: Observation is supplied to the independence test. The environmental sensing and recording chain is not constructed here.

Memory.name: PerspectiveMemory
Memory.note: Body- and perspective-indexed Memory; not a universal Memory construction.

Model.name: PerspectiveModel
Model.note: Body- and perspective-indexed Model joining represented Perception and Memory to subsequent States.

Action.name: Action
Action.note: A Body-indexed, Boundary-admitted crossing from Interior to Environment.

Consequence.name: CognitivePipeline
Consequence.note: Consequence is a supplied carrier in this pipeline, not a constructed causal Change. Dependence.dependentOutput is also explicitly not canonical Consequence.

Interpretation.name: Interpretation
Interpretation.note: This candidate processes Perception and distinguishes available Actions. It does not supply the full Memory/Model join of the prose.

Agent.name: Agent
Agent.note: An Agent of a fixed Body, joined to that Body’s Interpretation and exact Action.

Agency.name: Agency
Agency.note: The existing Body-indexed candidate. Its contribution must be exactly the Interpretation’s contribution and produce the Agent’s exact Action.

Tool.note: No corresponding Tool declaration exists in the audited Lean sources. A generic Entity parameter would omit its use by an Agent.

Interior.name: Body
Interior.note: The Body’s State Specification and recurring Transformation membership obligations. This does not independently classify all interior Transformations.

Exposure.name: Action
Exposure.note: The crossing conditions of this Action candidate, not a general Exposure predicate.

Interface.name: OperationalInterface
Interface.note: A predicate exposing Transformations. The source does not construct the complete Boundary- and Entity-indexed Interface.

Claim.name: TruthSemantics
Claim.note: Claim is a supplied type with semantic accessors. Its Agent, Representation and Scope are not constructed as a canonical Claim record here.

Witness.name: IndependentFor
Witness.note: Witness is supplied to the independence construction, not derived as a producer of an Observation.

Control.name: IndependentFor
Control.note: A supplied control predicate and its negation for the claimant. This is not the full Control construction.

Order.name: InstitutionalOrder
Order.note: Institutional judgment predicates; this record does not construct a persistent Configuration.

Principal.name: InstitutionalOrder
Principal.note: A supplied Principal carrier and recognition predicate, not a Principal derived from canonical Standing.

ActsFor.name: SovereigntySemantics
ActsFor.note: An opaque relation used in the sovereignty example. Its canonical Recognition and Scope conditions are not constructed.

CountsAs.name: InstitutionalValuation
CountsAs.note: A proposal-local institutional valuation projection, not a universal CountsAs construction.

Authority.name: Authority
Authority.note: The core module’s institutional encoding. The broader institutional-revision candidates remain separate proposals.

Declaration.name: AdmissibilityRuleProvenance
Declaration.note: A supplied Declaration and authorization witness; no canonical Action submitting a Claim is constructed.

Grant.name: Grant
Grant.note: The current Grant record is not itself typed as a canonical Declaration.

Admission.name: InstitutionalOrder
Admission.note: A supplied institutional admission predicate over numeric identifiers and time, not a complete Admission record.

Revocation.name: InstitutionalOrder
Revocation.note: A supplied institutional revocation predicate, not a Declaration under Authority.

PermissionExercise.name: PermissionExercise
PermissionExercise.note: This Lean record supplies permission, feasibility and non-revocation conditions, but has no field witnessing that the Action actually occurred.

Exercisability.name: PermissionExercise
Exercisability.note: The available general record carries the conjuncts of exercisability, despite its PermissionExercise name. It is not relabelled as a proved equivalent of the prose.

Enforcement.name: SovereigntySemantics
Enforcement.note: A supplied effect predicate in the boundary-sovereignty example; general Enforcement is not constructed.

Role.note: No corresponding institutional Role declaration exists in the audited Lean sources. The unrelated ParticipationRole draft is not this definition.

AdmissibilityRule.name: AdmissibilityRuleProvenance
AdmissibilityRule.note: The Rule’s authorization provenance is constructed; the Rule carrier and authorized predicate remain supplied.

Evidence.name: EvidenceAdmission
Evidence.note: A proposal-local admission construction with supplied Observation and independence semantics, and a supporting disposition. It is narrower than general Evidence.

Attestation.note: No corresponding Attestation declaration exists in the audited Lean sources.

Institution.name: handoffAt
Institution.note: Institution is a supplied carrier in this succession test. Its persistence, Rules and Roles are not constructed here.

Center.note: No corresponding Center declaration exists in the audited Lean sources.

Organ.name: BodilyOrganization
Organ.note: Organs are supplied participants in the bodily organization model, not independently constructed general Organs.

CanonicalSystem.note: No corresponding CanonicalSystem declaration exists in the audited Lean sources.

ShadowSystem.note: No corresponding ShadowSystem declaration exists in the audited Lean sources.

Person.note: No corresponding Person declaration exists in the audited Lean sources. MoralPersonhoodDesignation is a different term.

Receipt.note: No corresponding Receipt declaration exists in the audited Lean sources.

Ledger.name: PriceSemantics
Ledger.note: An opaque recorded-in-ledger predicate over supplied records, not a constructed ordered Ledger.

Polity.name: SovereigntySemantics
Polity.note: A supplied carrier in the sovereignty model, not an independent Polity construction.

ConstituentExercise.name: ConstituentSovereignty
ConstituentExercise.note: Witnesses the supplied constitutes relation; does not construct the full Agency-based Constituent Exercise.

ConstituentPower.name: SovereigntySemantics
ConstituentPower.note: An opaque predicate in the sovereignty model, not derived from Capability.

Truth.name: TruthSemantics.isTrue
Truth.note: The target lies in a supplied reality model. A bridge from that carrier to unrestricted Reality is not supplied.

InternalActivitySelection.name: InternalActivitySelection
InternalActivitySelection.note: A restricted temporal selection witness: rejected output precedes selected output. Canonical D111 does not require that ordering.

Attention.name: tracks
Attention.note: Current directed sensitivity over a scoped trace. Entity identity, canonical Perception/Interpretation, uninterrupted continuity and Causal Contribution remain supplied or unproved. Historical Attention records are not used.

Care.name: responsive
Care.note: Current response- and Specification-sensitive selection predicate. It does not construct canonical Attention, Action, Consequence or the same-target causal join. Historical Care is not used.

Respect.name: admitted
Respect.note: Current scoped admission predicate: an expressed condition overrides the contextual default. Condition provenance, consent and causal regulation remain outside this predicate. Historical Respect is not used.
